notes.title: Mislight Update 2.0 Release + 40% Discount on Winter Sale
notes.notes:
It's been 6 months since we launched our indie game Mislight ✨
To celebrate, we are releasing version 2.0 just in time for the Steam Winter Sale with a 40% discount!❄️

We've been working on this big update for the past month thanks to a lot of feedback we got from the community and it addresses stuff like:

- Fixing and reworking wonky level design
- Attack balancing
- Enemy balancing
- Tileset & background redesign
- Music reworking and mastering
- Various bug fixes

We hope that the overall experience for current players is greatly improved with this patch⚙️

And if you haven't checked Mislight out yet, go grab it while it's 40% OFF during the Winter Sale! 💸
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208220/Mislight/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208220/Mislight/[/url]

notes.title: Update Note 1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We just released a patch fixing some minor bugs that have been appearing the last week, first we are sorry for the inconvenience and we have already fixed these bugs.

The bugs we fixed are:

- Fixed a bug that didn't let the player buy costumes in the Shop.
- Fixed a bug that didn't let the game recognize the controller.

We thank you all that have been reporting bugs within the game, as this allow us to keep patching and fixing minor problems.

Thank you all and we hope you enjoy the game! 💖
